artworks.title: A Sunset in Ireland
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a natural scene with a wide perspective of the landscape. A river winds through the middle ground, flanked by trees. Fine engravings and cross-hatched lines create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from black to white to convey light and shadow.

artworks.title: Laneham
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an old stone building with gothic windows. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with a grassy area in front of the entrance where tall grass grows. The entrance has a stone archway, partially in shadow, with a person standing inside. The building occupies most of the vertical space, showcasing intricate details on the stonework and high walls. Fine lines and a linear texture are used for depth and texture on the stone surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: Whistler No. 6
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing two men's heads in profile. The upper figure has their eyes closed and faces right, with prominent cheekbones, a defined nose, a mustache, and styled dark hair. The lower figure is in profile, facing left, with softer facial features, a slightly upturned nose, and curly hair. Both figures have peaceful expressions. They are set against a textured background created by diagonal cross-hatching, giving a sense of depth and movement.

artworks.title: Whistler No. 4
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring multiple overlapping poses and expressions of a man's portrait. The portrayals capture the man's upper body and face, with some showing shoulders. The man is depicted in various profiles with his head tilted in different directions. He has a distinctive mustache and wavy hair. The etching outlines facial features and hair texture. The man wears a suit with a jacket and shirt in all representations. The background is blank. Some sketches hint at gesturing elements with partially depicted hands.

artworks.title: Fish Market, Antwerp
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban market scene with historical architecture in the background. The horizon is low, showcasing the pointed roofs and castle-like structures. Wicker baskets are seen on the ground for trade. People in period clothing are engaged in market activities, with one person managing the baskets and another walking with a basket. A decorated column and a street lamp are present. The architecture features detailed stonework and steep roofs, depicted with delicate brushstrokes. The color palette includes browns, ochres, and sepias, with touches of red in the clothing for contrast.

artworks.title: Hospice des Viellards, Gand
artworks.description: The image shows a painting of a grand, gothic-style building viewed from a slightly low angle. The building features tall, arched windows and detailed stonework, with a gable roof. The lower portion of the scene includes greenery and textures suggesting grass or shrubbery. The artist uses soft brushstrokes, noticeable in the sky and shading on the building. The color palette includes earthy tones on the building, contrasting with the blue of the windows and sky. A figure in a brown robe walks along a path nearby, and in the distance, two cypress trees are visible against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Confidences
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men sitting on a bench with their full bodies visible. The man on the left leans slightly towards the man on the right. The man on the right rests his left arm on his lap and looks towards his companion. Facial features are depicted with the left man in shadow and the other man's face showing more detail, including a beard. The man on the left wears what seems to be a suit or formal jacket, with darker shoes and knee-high socks. The man on the right is also dressed in formal attire, possibly a suit, with a darker cloak or coat over his shoulder. The background is abstract with a pattern suggesting foliage or an outdoor setting, using hatching and textured lines. The image has a monochromatic, etched style.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman in Profile
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a side profile drawing of a person with curly red hair intricately braided into a bun. The person's facial features include a prominent nose, full lips, and a soft chin. They are wearing a simple top and a necklace made of beads. The background is a blend of soft, muted colors with a light sepia tone.

artworks.title: Two Nudes
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude figure from a side view on all fours, with the left knee and left hand supporting the body's weight. The person's head is lowered, with strands of dark hair extending over the back and neck. There are no details provided about any clothing or jewelry, as the figure is unclothed. The background is plain and unadorned to highlight the sketched figure. The composition is simple and monochromatic, emphasizing the lines and curves of the body.

artworks.title: The Apocalypse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a majestic scene with a throne atop an ornate structure surrounded by clouds. A central figure adorned with elaborate garments and a headdress sits on the throne, emanating a glow. Cherubic figures are nestled within clouds around the central figure. Figures in flowing robes gather around the base of the structure. The background includes rolling hills and distant structures. The artwork features detailed linework to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Opening of the Fifth and Sixth Seals
artworks.description: This is a print depicting two connected scenes. The upper part of the print shows a heavenly assembly surrounded by swirling clouds. The assembly is filled with angels, as well as some men who are kneeling, looking upward at one angel who stands behind a desk or table. This central angel seems to hand the kneeling men long garments, which the other angles help them put on. At the bottom of this scene, shooting stars seem to descend towards the earthly realm below, which is shown at the bottom of the print. This lower scene is chaotic, with the shooting stars landing among a group of cowering people with expressions of distress. In the background, some low mountains are visible. Where the heavenly and earthly scenes meet, there are two large shapes of the sun and moon to the left and right, each with human faces. Their brows are furrowed and their lips are set in frowns.

artworks.title: Soho (recto)
artworks.description: The image features a landscape drawing depicting a river meandering through a winter scene. The horizon is marked by a line of trees, with a waterfall centrally located. Leafless trees with twisting trunks frame the scene, alongside a small structure partially hidden by branches. The drawing is executed in a bold, expressive style with black and gray tones against an off-white background.

artworks.title: Study for "Soho" (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of intersecting lines and curved shapes enclosed within a square border. The central focus is an oval shape intersected by vertical and horizontal lines. Vertical lines on the left and right edges resemble tall pillars or skyscrapers, while arcs above and below the oval shape suggest a dome or canopy. The arrangement of lines and shapes hints at architectural elements of a cityscape or a theatrical setting.

artworks.title: View of the Needles, and White Cliffs Taken from Allum Bay, Isle of Wight
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene from an elevated position. In the foreground, there is a gently sloping grassy area with sheep grazing and a few people. The horizon is high in the image where the sea meets the sky, with sailboats on the water. The brushstrokes are subtle, creating a soft portrayal of the landscape. The color palette includes earthy tones with beiges, greens, and blues. White cliffs extend towards the water on the right side.

artworks.title: The Shades of French Soldiers from the Past Exhort the Army to Victory on the Rhine
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink, black watercolor, and white gouache over graphite on wove paper, laid down on heavy paper
artworks.creditLine: Helen Porter and James T. Dyke Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of various figures holding flags and swords against an evening sky. The scene appears to be a military or triumphant moment, with figures gathered around, possibly atop a hill. The evening sky features a glowing moon partially obscured by clouds, casting light over the landscape. The figures in the painting are drawn in a sketch-like manner, hinting at movement and emotion, with many holding their hands and arms aloft. The earth tones and rough outlines give the painting a sense of urgency and vibrancy. This is in the style of Franz von Menzel.

artworks.title: The Germans Arrive
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ian and Annette Cumming
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting soldiers and distressed figures in a dark, dramatic scene. The artwork is in black and white with strong contrasts. The central focus is on a soldier, wearing a helmet, supporting another figure. The latter appears limp. To the left, a couple is shown in a fearful embrace, while on the right, a group of soldiers with rifles stand ready. The background features an ominous sky. The figures' postures and expressions convey a narrative of violence and suffering.

artworks.title: Hôtel de la Marine
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a street lamp in front of an architectural structure. The lamp is tall and ornate, placed centrally in the image, at the corner of a stone-paved street. In the background, a large, light-colored stone column is visible, part of a building facade with a high arch and a window to the right. The lighting emphasizes the textures of the materials, providing a structured appearance. The setting conveys a sense of historic architecture and urban environment.

artworks.title: Petit profil (Seated Girl Wearing a Red Coat and a Blue Hat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: This image shows a side profile of the upper body of a person, who appears to be a child. They are seated and facing to the left, with their head turned slightly so that their profile is visible. The child has short, brown hair peeking out from under a blue hat that has a red pom-pom on top. They are wearing a bright red garment with a white collar. The child is seated on a simple wooden chair. The background of the image is a muted purplish color.

artworks.title: Women and Nuns Seated in Church
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image shows three people sitting in chairs, seen from behind. The individual in the front is wearing a dark-colored coat and a large hat with a veil. The person to the left has a tan hat and coat. In the background, two more figures are wearing bonnets, one in orange and the other in white. They are seated in wooden chairs indoors, possibly in a café or meeting hall. The background is a mix of soft brown and cream colors.

artworks.title: Jeune Fille (à la lampe) (Young Girl by Lamplight)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person's upper body facing forward with head slightly turned to the left. The shoulder and facial features, like eyes, lips, nose, and hair are detailed. The clothing is also sketched with light strokes, and the person seems to be holding part of the garment near the neck. The background is plain without any distinct elements.

artworks.title: Les chapeaux à brides (Schoolgirls Wearing Brimmed Hats)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals wearing green hats, lying down or reclining on a grassy surface. The individuals are positioned closely together. The background includes flowers with white and pink blossoms, and a distant fence or structure.

artworks.title: Street at Night, Meudon
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld

artworks.title: Cat with a White Front
artworks.medium: gouache, watercolor, and graphite on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: This is a painting of a seated cat facing the right. Its fur is depicted in reddish-brown tones, with white areas around the neck and chest. Its eyes are closed, and its front legs are straight, with its paws placed together. The lines outlining the cat are loose and fluid, capturing the cat's form with minimal detail. The background is yellow paper.

artworks.title: Seated Girl in a High Collared Cloak
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mimi and Sanford Feld
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a person from the torso up. The individual is seated and facing to the right, with their hands resting in their lap. The facial features are minimally detailed, with a delicate depiction of the face in profile, showing a light skin tone and simple features with short, light brown hair peeking out from under a dark head covering. The person is draped in a dark garment that covers their shoulders and most of the upper body, with a hint of white visible at the wrists suggesting an inner layer of clothing. There are no visible jewelry items or objects being held. The background is a uniform, muted brown, without any distinguishable elements or patterns.
